sections.herbal_remedies:
Slow, fast or irregular heart beat is normally related to our emotional behavior. Do you have any idea, what is Abnormal Heart Rhythm? Have you ever seen anyone diagnosed with this problem? Irregular heart beat is the condition when heart is not able to pump blood efficiently which results in the Abnormal Heart Rhythm. Shortness of breath, chest pain, irregular pulse, heart palpitations and sweating are the symptoms associated with this problem. So don’t take these symptoms lightly because it may lead to serious health complications like stroke, heart failure and Alzheimer’s disease.


In Ayurveda, Abnormal Heart Rhythm (Arrhythmia) falls under the category of hridroga (heart diseases). There are three energies – vata, pitta and kapha in our body which helps to maintain a good health. Imbalance of any of three energies results in the health complications. Abnormal Heart Rhythm is due to the imbalance of all three energies (vata, pitta and kapha).

sections.types_of_abnormal_heart_rhythm:
Tachycardia – Tachycardia means that when heart beat is too fast. Normally heart beats 60-100 times per minutes. Whereas in tachycardia heart beats faster than 100 beats per minutes. 
 Atrial fibrillation (AF) – Atrial fibrillation is the most common arrhythmia. In this case heart beat gets increased up to 100- 200 beats per minute. 
 Bradycardia – In this case the heart beat is slow which less than 60 beats per minute.
